Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: latency & throughput benchmarks

Alex — great to meet today. Quick recap and the artifacts I promised from the engineering run: attached are our measured p50/p95/p99 numbers across the 2 model variants you asked about plus the raw load test CSV.

What we covered (high level):
- Model variants: rwd-7b-q4 and rwd-13b-fp16 (we ran both at beam=1 for latency comparability)
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 measured at 1, 8, and 32 concurrent requests; p95 for rwd-7b-q4 was ~42ms at batch=1 and ~90ms at batch=8; p99 tail spiked to ~210ms at peak load (see PDF)
- Throughput: with our continuous batching enabled, sustained throughput for rwd-13b-fp16 reached ~420 tokens/sec on a single GPU with batch sizing tuned for 90th percentile latency targets
- KV cache: warm cache reduces p95 by ~25% for repeated session workloads (relevant to your chat use case)
- Quantization impact: q4 gives ~1.7x cost improvement with modest ~5-8% latency improvement depending on prompt length

Attachments: redwood-latency-benchmarks-2026-06-24.pdf (summary) and loadtest-results-2026-06-24.csv (raw logs).

Suggested next steps:
1) Quick internal sync — if you want, I can run a short 20-min call next week with Dylan (SE) to walk the benchmarks and map them to your expected request distribution.
2) If you prefer, we can provision a short PoC on dedicated infra so you can run your own load tests with your prompts and tokens.
3) Procurement: I can open a procurement path and share a mutual action plan if you want to move towards Dedicated or Reserved capacity.

Questions I still have for your infra team:
- Expected average prompt length and completion length (tokens) per request
- Desired p95 SLA and traffic ramp cadence

Thanks again — happy to schedule the SE deep-dive.

Best,
